description: Rental Bond Data (NSW) is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by NSW Government - Fair Trading. Data by New South Wales Fair Trading for recent rental bond lodgements and refunds as well as data on the total rental bond holdings. Data consists of Postcodes to link geography. Data updated monthly. Provides information on Weekly Rental Price, Dwelling Type, Number of Bedrooms, Bond Payment to Tenant, Days Bond Held and Total Bonds in Postcode. Coverage is the states and territories, 2016 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
